title: Bit Better Survival
description: Basic modpack made for survival, features performance modes, QOL mods and shaders and resource packs, adding minimal features.
body:
# Minimal Survival Pack
## Not a lot of features
### Major ones are:
1. Ambient Sounds, Better Particles.
2. Hand Picked Shaderpacks And Texturepacks
3. Whole Lot Of Performance Mods.
4. Compasses that find biomes and structres.
5. Waypoint things
**So in short, just a small optimised modpack with not a lot of features, really good performance tho !**
